name: slouch_bench
text: A person starts sitting upright on a bench and slowly leans their torso slightly backward into a relaxed seated pose. Both hands remain resting loosely on the upper thighs in the lap. Both feet stay on the floor in front of the bench. Stay seated and relaxed, with subtle breathing.
